daily.today_energy: Your vibe is expansive and curious today. The cosmos is inviting you to explore something new—whether that's a hobby, a conversation, or literally just a different route home. Trust that restless feeling.

daily.career: Today's energy supports taking initiative on something you've been thinking about. Your ideas have legs—don't wait for permission. Small moves toward what excites you create momentum.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and sunlight. Nothing intense needed; a walk, stretching, or just being outside will shift your energy. Hydration and good sleep are your quiet superpowers today.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are hitting different this week, Sag. You're in your communicative era and people are actually listening. Channel that fire energy into conversations that matter—the universe is co-signing your authenticity.
weekly.love: Whether single or coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Let someone see the real you beneath the jokes and adventure talk. Genuine connection happens when you stop performing and just exist.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are chef's kiss energy this week. Don't play small with your contributions—speak up in meetings and pitch that project you've been sitting on. Your instincts are reliable.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Dance, hike, or vibe with exercise that brings joy. Mental health check: journaling or talking to someone you trust will clear a lot of noise.
